title: Aerolite Book 14 Thin & Light Laptop (Core i5-class, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14 inch FHD)

sections.description: The Aerolite Book 14 is a thin and light laptop for students and professionals. It weighs just 1.4 kg and is 16.9 mm thin, with an aluminium lid and a backlit keyboard. The 14 inch Full HD IPS anti-glare display is comfortable for long work sessions. A 12-core Aerolite A7 processor, 16GB of RAM and a fast 512GB NVMe SSD handle multitasking, coding and light photo editing. The 56Wh battery delivers up to 10 hours of battery life, and 65W USB-C fast charging gets you to 50% in 30 minutes.

reviews: 5/5 - Great for college. Light enough to carry all day and the battery easily lasts through my classes, around 8 to 9 hours of note-taking and browsing.
4/5 - Fast and smooth. Boots in seconds and handles 30+ Chrome tabs, VS Code and Spotify without slowing down. 16GB RAM makes a big difference.
2/5 - Display is dull. The screen is only 300 nits and colours look washed out. Fine for documents but not for photo editing or watching movies.
4/5 - Battery life is good but not 10 hours. I get about 7 hours with Wi-Fi on and medium brightness. Still better than my old laptop.
5/5 - Excellent keyboard. Keys have good travel and the backlight is useful at night. Typing long assignments is comfortable.
3/5 - Webcam is poor. The 720p webcam looks grainy in video calls, especially in indoor light. Good that it has a privacy shutter.
4/5 - Good port selection. Having both USB-A and USB-C plus HDMI and an SD card reader means I do not need any dongles.
1/5 - Fan noise under load. When compiling code or on video calls the fan gets loud and the bottom gets warm. Not great in a quiet library.
5/5 - Value for money. With the student offer and bank discount I paid under 49,000. Office is included, which saves extra money.
3/5 - Speakers are weak. The speakers are quiet and lack bass. Use headphones for movies.
4/5 - Charges fast. The 65W USB-C charger gets it to about 50% in half an hour, and I can also charge my phone with the same charger.
2/5 - RAM cannot be upgraded. The 16GB RAM is soldered, so there is no way to upgrade later. The SSD can be upgraded though.
